cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: More Power, More Problems
cards.instruction: Celebrate every burden, restriction, or crisis as evidence that your influence is expanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Another customer complaint about me! I'm becoming the focus of this hotel.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm taking you off reception while I investigate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Wonderful. Now management is organizing its day around me too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll answer every complaint in writing from the laundry office.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My own correspondence operation, reaching into laundry. I'll need more paper.

mechanism: A credits its manager-pupil disciplinary response to its own teaching and celebrates each sanction as expansion of A influence.
confusable: Not denial that punishment happened: the punishment itself is treated as proof more people orbit A.
comparison: Traveling departmental burden versus disciplinary removal into laundry.
seedUse: D68 hotel/complaint/investigation/laundry; S05 grades former trainee who now restricts A.
